query:
UPDATE molecules SET 
  radar_intensity = 70,
  radar_freshness = 30,
  radar_warmth = 75,
  radar_sweetness = 40,
  radar_spiciness = 35,
  radar_earthiness = 60
WHERE (olfactiveProfile LIKE '%musc%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%musk%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%animal%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%ambre%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%amber%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%civette%')
  AND radar_intensity = 50 AND radar_freshness = 50
